name: hq-layout
description: Turns Claude into a headquarters: a deep-teal ink-wash look, a week strip above the prompt, and an HQ pane with a feed, today's plan, needs-you, metrics and workflows.

timeZone.title: Clock time zone
timeZone.description: IANA zone for the HQ clock and week strip, such as America/Chicago. Blank uses the machine's zone.

openOnStart.title: Open HQ on start
openOnStart.description: Open the HQ pane when a session starts.
